cohort: The study included pregnant women who delivered after 37 weeks of gestation.
finding: The study found that while overall FHR evolution patterns did not significantly differ with the presence of umbilical cord abnormalities, velamentous cord insertion specifically showed a higher prevalence of persistent non-reassuring (p-NR) and reactive-prolonged deceleration (PD) FHR patterns, and a lower prevalence of persistent reassuring patterns.
